title: Door Bundle Credit Amount and Grant
content:
# Door Bundle Credit Amount and Grant

Window Replacement Contracts — billing credit terms for a household that also holds Entry & Patio Door Contracts.

**Grant.** For a household holding exactly one Ridgeline door contract that is not cancelled, and only for such a household, the door bundle discount is granted on this window contract once, paired with that door contract, when that door contract was signed within the bundle window of calendar days before or after this contract's signed date, its discount program is none and this contract's discount program is none; otherwise such a household's window contract earns no door bundle discount; every other household remains under the base rule for when and how often the credit is granted and for its amount, and this policy figures no credit for it.

**Amount.** The standard door bundle credit is the window series bundle percentage times the signed contract price, rounded to the cent, booked as one door bundle discount credit dated the day it is granted.

The bundle window and the bundle percentage are the window series' figures in the credit schedule. A door contract is not cancelled when its status is signed, measured, ordered, installed or closed.

## Grant table (household with exactly one door contract not cancelled)

| Signing dates apart (calendar days, either order) | Door contract's discount program | Window contract's discount program | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Within the bundle window | None | None | Granted once, paired with that door contract |
| Within the bundle window | Any program | Any | Not earned |
| Within the bundle window | Any | Any program | Not earned |
| Outside the bundle window | Any | Any | Not earned |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A household holds one door contract signed 2035-04-20 and a window contract signed 2035-05-05 with a signed price of $20,000, both with no discount program, in a series with a hypothetical bundle percentage of 2.5%; the two signings are 15 days apart, within the bundle window. The credit is $500.00 (2.5% of $20,000).
